title: Transfer and Capture of Envelope Protein Receptor-Binding Domains in the Retroviruses
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2结构建模和系统发育分析研究逆转录病毒Env蛋白受体结合域（RBD）的转移与捕获，属于蛋白质-核酸（病毒Env与宿主受体）互作的结构演化研究，虽非TF-DNA体系，但结构建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作界面研究。
abstract: The surface subunit (SU) of the envelope protein (Env) or retroviruses is highly variable due to adaptation to different hosts during their long evolutionary history. Several exogenous and endogenous retroviral gamma-like Env have a receptor-binding domain (RBD) in the amino-terminal region of SU that folds independently from the carboxyterminal SU C-domain. Two structurally distinct RBD classes have been described, one that adopts a modified immunoglobulin (Ig)-like domain fold and a second, in the Env of RDR interference group retroviruses, with a distinct β-sheet fold. Here, the distribution of different RBD classes among exogenous and endogenous gammatype Env was determined by phylogenetic analyses of Env and structural modeling of retroviral SU with AlphaFold2. The patterns of RBD distribution indicate multiple RBD transfer events in the retroviruses. In addition, SU structural modeling identified an endogenous alpharetroviral-like Env in mammalian species with an amino-terminal RBD. This RDB has a typical IgV domain fold closely related both structurally and in sequence to the mammalian signal regulatory proteins (SIRP) α, β and γ, indicating, for the first time, acquisition of an RBD from a mammalian gene by the retroviruses. The results described herein indicate intragenic env recombination between retroviruses and between retroviruses and their hosts as a major factor in the evolution of retroviral Env.
abstract_zh: 包膜蛋白（Env）的表面亚基（SU）在逆转录病毒中因其长期进化历史中对不同宿主的适应而高度变异。若干外源性和内源性逆转录病毒γ样Env在SU的氨基末端区域含有一个受体结合域（RBD），该结构域独立于羧基末端SU C-结构域折叠。已描述两种结构上不同的RBD类别，一种采用修饰的免疫球蛋白（Ig）样结构域折叠，另一种存在于RDR干扰组逆转录病毒的Env中，具有独特的β-折叠结构。在此，通过Env的系统发育分析和逆转录病毒SU的AlphaFold2结构建模，确定了不同RBD类别在外源性和内源性γ型Env中的分布。RBD分布模式表明逆转录病毒中存在多次RBD转移事件。此外，SU结构建模在哺乳动物物种中识别出一种内源性α逆转录病毒样Env，其具有氨基末端RBD。该RBD具有典型的IgV结构域折叠，在结构和序列上与哺乳动物信号调节蛋白（SIRP）α、β和γ密切相关，首次表明逆转录病毒从哺乳动物基因中获得了RBD。本文所述结果表明，逆转录病毒之间以及逆转录病毒与其宿主之间的基因内env重组是逆转录病毒Env进化的主要因素。
